name: full
description: The committed broad coding panel for semantic and indexed-history Brain treatments. Distilled-fact effects belong to the separate temporal-memory panels. This manifest IS the run config: `python3 run.py panel full` expands it into the existing run path and prints a per-task stability verdict. Runners are fully pinned (agent:model:effort) so the proof is reproducible and the model is visible in the artifacts. Conditions intersect each task's own conditions (history-only tasks run no_brain+semantic_history_brain; semantic tasks add semantic_brain).

workspace_tasks.note: Cross-repo workspace scenario per agent_benchmark_plan.md ("Cross-repo workspace tasks"): break a plugin dispatch / env assumption where the fix could plausibly live in entire-brain OR ../cli, and measure whether the multi-brain workspace localizes it. NOT yet wired into the panel runner — a runnable workspace task needs the workspace harness (two pinned member repos + a hidden cross-repo regression). Tracked here so the panel's multi-repo coverage gap is explicit, not silently missing.
